steps.clue: Destroy the Aetherium Crystals to unlock Pack-a-Punch and activate the Particle Accelerator.
Complete the Syringe chain and open the T2 Teleportation Lab.
Activate Franken-Klaus, complete his S.A.M. Trial and escort him into the lab.
Order the four Project Janus files and enter their code into Franken-Klaus’s terminal.
Complete the Gorgofex, Project Janus brain and Fungal Head objectives.
Capture four floating objects with the Vacuum-Seal Devices.
Complete the portal lockdown, enter the portal and interact with the Sentinel Artifact.
Charge the L.T.G. Devices and destroy the Aether crystals to reach the rooftop.
Defeat S.A.M. or Uber Richtofen, depending on your chosen side.
